response.overview: # The story follows Ain Farhana (Hana) who is willing to maintain a household built with Azlan for 16 years for the sake of their two children, Hakimi and Haida. However, after discovering that Azlan is having a secret relationship with Aina, his trusted staff, it has a major impact on her patience and self-respect as a wife and employer. Azlan's confession along with his intention to make Hana accept Aina makes Hana realize that her sacrifices and efforts to save their household have been in vain. Hana is determined to divorce. After the divorce is finalized, Hana imagines she is free from the torment of love. But she is not. Azlan wants them to reconcile and at the same time, his intention to marry Aina continues. The thinking period requested by Azlan is like hell for Hana, who is frequently haunted by Aina's ghost, who supposedly feels guilty and wants to apologize. Azlan is unaware that his actions are making Hana more depressed.
response.title: Bahagia Bukan Bidaan
